name: itemdex
description: ITEMDEX - catalog your stuff as retro collectible cards, powered by AI

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @itemdex/server" "npm run dev -w @itemdex/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @itemdex/server && npm run build -w @itemdex/web
scripts.desktop: npm run build -w @itemdex/web && npm run build -w @itemdex/desktop && npm run start -w @itemdex/desktop
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build -w @itemdex/web && npm run dist -w @itemdex/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p apps/desktop
